package.title: From unified discounting to dual-risk: A new lens on DCF valuation
package.data_as_of: Daily prices from 1 January 2015 to 30 December 2024. Bitcoin and US equity data retrieved 23 November 2026; gold retrieved in 2025.
package.units: Rates (c, c_eff) are fractions a year (0.13 is 13% a year). K is a ratio; the raw gain is K - 1. Shares are fractions of the weeks. Relative differences are fractions of the published value.

licence.condition: Reuse of the results is allowed with credit to the paper.
licence.third_party_data: data/btc_daily.csv is the PriceUSD series of the Coin Metrics community data, licensed CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial use, with attribution). data/us_market_daily.csv is from the Kenneth R. French data library, copyright Eugene F. Fama and Kenneth R. French. data/gld_daily.csv is the daily close of SPDR Gold Shares from Yahoo Finance. Third-party data keep their own terms and are not covered by the licence above.

tables.what: The weekly series, one row per week and asset, from the last week of 2016.

columns.week_ending: the Friday that ends the week
columns.price: the last price of the week: US dollars for BTC and GLD, an index (100 at 2 January 2015) for US_MARKET
columns.c: benchmark rate, a fraction a year: max(0.03, (P_t / P_{t-104})^(1/2) - 1)
columns.K: valuation ratio P_{t+52} / (P_t (1 + c)); empty in the last 52 weeks
columns.c_eff: effective rate, (1 + c)/K - 1, a fraction a year

tables.what: Table 3 recomputed: statistics of the benchmark rate c over 419 weeks.

columns.excess_kurtosis: kurtosis less 3, without bias adjustment; not in the paper's table

Table 5 recomputed: statistics of the effective rate c_eff over 367 weeks. Columns as in table3_c_stats.csv.

columns.article_label: the asset's label in the paper

columns.published: the value printed in the paper
columns.relative_difference: difference divided by the absolute published value
columns.equal_as_printed: 1 if rebuilt, rounded to the paper's decimals, equals published
